<aside class="blog-tldr not-prose"><div class="blog-tldr__label">TL;DR</div><div class="blog-tldr__body">
- 721 hospitals across 188 CBSAs
- Five surgical procedure categories
- Up to 20% revenue at risk
- Program runs through 2030
</div></aside>

## The numbers that define CMS TEAM

- **721** — participants listed on CMS’s TEAM webpage. (Trade sources variously cite 714, ~740, 741 or 742; CMS’s figure is authoritative.)
- **188** — selected CBSAs (~23.4% of eligible), per Applied Policy and Milliman.
- **5** — surgical episode categories (LEJR, SHFFT, spinal fusion, CABG, major bowel).
- **30** — days in the post-discharge episode window.
- **5 years** — January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2030.
- **$481 million** — CMS-projected Medicare savings over five years (FY2025 IPPS Final Rule: TEAM "will save the Medicare program approximately $481 million over the 5 performance years").
- **~198,000** — estimated annual TEAM surgical procedures nationally, per Milliman: "there are roughly 198,000 TEAM surgical procedures annually, with about 114,000 (58%) occurring in the inpatient setting."
- **~$14,000** — average cost of a readmission in a TEAM episode, per Milliman.
- **$18,723** — average 2024 30-day LEJR episode cost at TEAM hospitals, per Trilliant Health.
- **10% / 5% / 20%** — Track 1/2/3 stop-gain limits.
- **Up to 10% / 15%** — CQS reconciliation adjustment (positive / negative, by track).
- **56%** — share of mandatory participants Optum Advisory projects could lose money, averaging $1.2M/facility.
- **~93** — estimated California hospitals mandated (IAC estimate).

<aside class="blog-callout blog-callout--default not-prose"><div class="blog-callout__body">

- Rainfall Health’s own figures (attributed to the company, not independently verified): up to 20% of Medicare revenue at stake
- up to $85M five-year upside.

</div></aside>

## Frequently asked questions

### How many hospitals are mandated under CMS TEAM?

721 hospitals, per CMS’s official TEAM participant list.

### How many CBSAs does CMS TEAM cover?

188 selected Core-Based Statistical Areas, roughly 23.4% of eligible markets nationwide.

### How much is CMS TEAM projected to save Medicare?

CMS projects approximately $481 million in Medicare savings over the model’s five performance years (2026–2030).

### What is the average readmission cost in a CMS TEAM episode?

Roughly $14,000 per readmission, according to Milliman.

### How many procedures occur under CMS TEAM annually?

Milliman estimates roughly 198,000 TEAM surgical procedures occur annually nationwide, with about 58% performed in the inpatient setting.
